environment.concurrent_workload: Other agents may run builds/tests on the same host; no CPU isolation/governor control

scope: Offline lexical rank() on current public skills and synthetic metadata; excludes Hub filesystem/catalog assembly, transport I/O, upstream connection and LLM success/token measurements

method.ranking_equality: Exact returned dictionaries, including scores and schemas, compared per query for all engines
method.cache: Warm cache prefilled once, cold cache creates a new instance per call; selected metadata normalisation and hashing remain in measured rank().
method.output_bytes: Compact UTF-8 JSON payload only, excluding JSON-RPC/content envelope and actual schema consent wrapping. Chosen detail simulated with current Document.value; no LLM token estimator.

followups.change: Check len(selected)>2000 before metadata JSON serialization
followups.limitations: Other agents run tests concurrently on the same host; no CPU isolation. Different workload/run timing prevents attributing before/after latency differences solely to the bypass change. Cache remains bypassed, not warmed.
